subject.title: fix(ci): script-only changes cold-start every Node job

question: Should this protected CI cache-contract change merge with cold-path proof plus an explicit post-merge protected warm-hit verification, or should it wait for a maintainer-controlled protected-lane proof first?
rationale: A PR clone intentionally cannot publish the protected sticky-disk marker, so neither contributor testing nor ordinary PR CI can establish the central v2 warm-hit without changing the trust boundary; accepting staged rollout is a maintainer operational decision.

options.title: Approve staged protected rollout
options.body: Merge only after the head is refreshed, then monitor the first protected writer and a following protected consumer for the documented v2 warm-hit log.

options.title: Require pre-merge protected proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a maintainer can run an equivalent trusted-lane validation that proves marker publication and a subsequent warm-hit.

recommendation.title: Approve staged protected rollout
recommendation.body: Merge only after the head is refreshed, then monitor the first protected writer and a following protected consumer for the documented v2 warm-hit log.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person directly to the CI fingerprint design and rollout evidence; confidence is limited because current-main blame/history could not be independently inspected.
